title: EU Hits Cold-Rolled Steel Imports with Anti-Dumping Duties Up to 27.9% - News and Statistics
summary: The publisher provided no excerpt, and the headline does not list the countries affected. Other reports in this batch indicate that Japan and Vietnam are among the origins covered.
whyItMatters: The duties tighten access to the EU flat steel market and reflect continued European trade defence. This could prompt trade diversion of cold-rolled volumes towards other import markets, including Asia.
implications: EU buyers may see higher import costs and a narrower set of supply origins, which could support domestic mills' pricing. Exporters in affected countries may need to find alternative outlets.

related.title: EU anti-dumping duties imposed on cold-rolled flat steel from India, Japan, Taiwan, Turkiye, Vietnam
related.dek: The EU has imposed anti-dumping duties on cold-rolled flat steel from India, Japan, Taiwan, Turkiye and Vietnam, Goodreturns reports.

related.title: EU Imposes 16% Anti-Dumping Duties on Vietnamese Cold-Rolled Steel... POSCO Also Included
related.dek: The EU has imposed 16% anti-dumping duties on cold-rolled steel from Vietnam, with POSCO also covered, according to Financial News.

related.title: EU sets tariff on certain Vietnamese cold-rolled flat steel products
related.dek: The EU has set a tariff on certain Vietnamese cold-rolled flat steel products, according to SGGP English Edition.

related.title: EU applies anti-dumping duty on Vietnamese cold-rolled steel products
related.dek: The EU has applied an anti-dumping duty on cold-rolled steel products from Vietnam, the Vietnam Economic Times reports.
